newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania C.Bank sells dollars to prop leu.
newsitem.headline: Romania C.Bank sells dollars to prop leu.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) intervened on the local interbank market on Friday, selling dollars to contain growing pressure on the leu after the currency dipped about 2.5 percent on Thursday, dealers said.
"The BNR is intervening on the market now. It sold me some dollars," said one trader.

Some traders said the BNR's intervention rates ranged from 7,300 to 7,350 lei to the dollar. The leu firmed slightly to 7,200/400 to the dollar after the intervention against large spreads of 7,400/600 in early trading.
